description: Turn a bet described in words into Arena instrument ids and the Kalshi ticker and side to buy. Examples: 'chiefs ml', 'kc -3.5', 'mia +3.5', 'kc mia under 44.5 sunday', 'eagles -2.5 monday'. Covers the full-game moneylines, spreads and totals on half-point lines that Arena lists in the NFL, college football, MLB, the NHL, the NBA and the Premier League (say draw for a soccer draw); player props and whole-number lines return no rows. When a team name is used in more than one league, add the other team or the league (nhl rangers ml). It never guesses: every word must be understood and a team is required, so an empty result means rephrase, not that no market exists. A total must say over or under: 'kc mia 44.5' returns no rows. Every total is both teams combined; team totals are not covered. With one team named, a total also needs the word game or combined, or (in the NFL) a line of 35 or more: 'chiefs over 24.5' returns no rows because that is how a Chiefs team total is written, while 'chiefs game over 24.5', 'kc mia over 24.5' and 'chiefs u44.5' resolve to the game total. Time words: a day (today, tonight, tomorrow or a weekday) and a time of day (night, evening, afternoon or morning), as in 'rams ml sunday night'. Without a day it returns every unfinished game for those teams, earliest first, so check which game each row is. Spreads and totals are added closer to kickoff. Each instrument states yes_means (what YES on the instrument pays for) and query_means (what your words pay for). To hold exactly what you asked, buy kalshi[].buy_side on kalshi[].ticker, or pass instrument_id with instrument_side set to query_side. 'mia +3.5' resolves to the instrument 'KC wins by more than 3.5' with query_side no, so its buy_side is no on the KC market. Rows run earliest game first: check starts_at and the teams before acting. instrument_id is Arena's durable id: store it as given, never build or parse it. Call get_market (it takes the ticker or the instrument_id) for a live price before place_trade. Set full=true to get every upstream field instead of the compact row.

query.description: The bet in plain words, e.g. 'chiefs ml', 'kc -3.5' or 'over 44.5 chiefs dolphins'. Required.

name: resolve_market
title: Resolve a bet in words
